text: The glass roof should open fully, not just tilt.
I bought the 5 Series expecting an opening sunroof like my previous one. Big disappointment.
The glass roof lets in too much heat on summer afternoons.
The shade for the glass roof is slow and noisy.
Love the light the glass roof brings into the cabin.
My phone overheats on the wireless charging pad and stops charging.
My phone slides off the charging pad in fast corners.
The front seats need ventilation for hot summers.
